description.zh: 业务日期。一般是周期实例定时时间的前一天的0点0分0秒，格式为毫秒级时间戳，如1743350400000。
description.en: The business date. This is generally 00:00:00 of the day before the scheduled instance trigger time, in millisecond-level timestamp format, such as 1743350400000.

description.zh: 过滤器。JSON格式，多个过滤条件之间是"且"的关系。目前支持的字段有：`status, executionDate`。
description.en: The filter. In JSON format, multiple filter conditions have an AND relationship. Currently supported fields are: `status, executionDate`.

description.zh: 工作流实例ID列表，可根据工作流实例Id批量查询多个工作流实例信息。
description.en: The list of workflow instance IDs. You can use this parameter to query multiple workflow instances at a time.
The name. Fuzzy match is supported.
The account ID of the owner.
The page number, starting from 1. Default value: 1.
The number of entries per page. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
排序字段列表，支持定时时间、开始时间等字段。格式为"排序字段+排序方式(Desc/Asc)"（Asc可以缺省）。排序字段的枚举值如下：
- TriggerTime (Desc/Asc)
- StartedTime (Desc/Asc)
- FinishedTime (Desc/Asc)
- CreateTime (Desc/Asc)
- Id (Desc/Asc)

默认值：Id Desc
description.en:
The list of sort fields. Sorting by trigger time, start time, and other fields is supported. The format is "sort field + sort order (Desc/Asc)" (Asc can be omitted). Valid values of the sort field:

- TriggerTime (Desc/Asc)

- StartedTime (Desc/Asc)

- FinishedTime (Desc/Asc)

- CreateTime (Desc/Asc)

- Id (Desc/Asc)

Default value: Id Desc

description.zh: 标签列表，多个标签中满足一个即会返回结果。
description.en: The list of tags. Results are returned if any one of the specified tags is matched.

description.zh:
工作流实例的类型。
- Normal：周期调度
- Manual：手动任务
- SmokeTest：测试
- SupplementData：补数据
- ManualWorkflow：手动工作流
- TriggerWorkflow：触发式工作流
description.en:
The type of the workflow instance.

- Normal: Periodic scheduling

- Manual: Manual task

- SmokeTest: Testing

- SupplementData: Backfill data

- ManualWorkflow: Manual workflow

- TriggerWorkflow: Trigger-based workflow

description.zh: 统一工作流实例Id，某次触发下某业务日期内的所有工作流实例的该字段值相等。
description.en: The unified workflow instance ID. All workflow instances within the same business date of a single trigger share the same value for this field.
The ID of the workflow to which the instance belongs.

descriptions.zh: 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用。
descriptions.en: Available with DataWorks Basic Edition or higher.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public list-workflow-instances --project-id 100 --biz-date 1710239005403 --type Normal --workflow-id 1234 --unified-workflow-instance-id 1234 --name WorkflowInstance1 --ids 1234 --owner 1000 --sort-by Id_Desc --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --tags key:value --filter status_:_Success_,_executionDate_:_1763481600000 --env-type Prod --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public ListWorkflowInstances --region cn-hangzhou --Owner 1000 --PageSize 10 --SortBy Id_Desc --ProjectId 100 --WorkflowId 1234 --UnifiedWorkflowInstanceId 1234 --EnvType Prod --Name WorkflowInstance1 --Type Normal --PageNumber 1 --Filter 'status_:_Success_,_executionDate_:_1763481600000' --Ids '[1234]' --BizDate 1710239005403 --Tags '["key:value"]'
